summary: A callable Proxy is constructable only when its target is a constructor; a construct trap cannot add [[Construct]] to a non-constructor target.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.capability: [[Construct]] is installed only if target is callable and IsConstructor(target) is true
semantics.result: when trap is used it must return an Object

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.

tests.name: arrow target cannot be made constructable
tests.input: const P=new Proxy(()=>1,{construct(){return {ok:true}}});try{new P()}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
